input.headline: Haaland rewards his captains as Cherki's buyers get nothing and Brighton run riot

cards.badge: Scored in 6 gameweeks in a row
cards.text: Haaland has been the most-captained player for 7 gameweeks in a row, and his 2 goals plus maximum bonus made the armband pay handsomely.

cards.title: Chelsea's popular picks blanked
cards.text: Chelsea won 0-2 at Everton, yet the goals bypassed the two attackers most managers trusted. João Pedro was also the most popular vice-captain.

cards.title: The top scorer hardly anyone had
cards.text: Neto produced his best score of the season, a windfall for the few who owned him while Chelsea's big names stalled.

cards.title: Brighton ran riot against Crystal Palace
cards.text: Brighton won 5-0 and made it 4 wins in a row. Most of the hauls landed in squads that barely held them.
Cherki's new owners got nothing as he sat out. The Szoboszlai sell-off was the biggest net move out of the season so far, and it looked wise.
